sources.title: Per capita consumption-based CO2 emissions
sources.publisher: Our World in Data / Global Carbon Project
sources.attribution: Global Carbon Budget 2025; Our World in Data processing. Consumption-based fossil CO2 per capita, 2024 series.

regionalAverage.methodology: Consumption-based fossil-fuel and industrial CO2 emissions per capita, adjusted for trade; excludes land-use change and international aviation/shipping from country totals.
regionalAverage.accountingBoundary: National consumption-based fossil CO2 per person; not a household all-gas CO2e lifestyle footprint.

emissionFactors.methodology: Pakistan grid electricity factor. The supplied source describes the 2025 release and validity year; the IGES List of Grid Emission Factors v11.6 cross-check remains a v1 release gate.
